description: Current status of a flight by number (e.g. AA1 or AAL1). Returns the canonical flight number and the leg its gaduin.com flight page answers with (today's leg in its own time zone, else the active leg nearest now, else the latest one; with date, that service date's leg), with its role (current: left and not landed, inside its arrival horizon; next: not yet left; latest: landed, cancelled, no arrival recorded, unconfirmed or past due with nothing recorded), its status (arrival_not_recorded once it left and no arrival was recorded by its scheduled arrival plus 6 hours, else its recorded departure plus 24 hours; timing is then null), whether sources disagree on its outcome, its timing, delay in minutes and on-time or delayed verdict under the late rule, its departure and arrival times in UTC and airport-local time with the time zone, the leg's own last update time (null when none), the aircraft type, registration and ICAO 24-bit address recorded for the operating flight's own leg (each null when not on record; always null on a codeshare listing), a link to the flight page and, when one is open, a link to the prediction market that page links (this leg's until it leaves, else the next upcoming leg's, with that leg's service date). on_record is true. It also returns observed: the flights read off positions reported by aircraft transponders under the flight number's broadcast callsign (matched_by callsign, with the callsigns tried; an airline whose callsigns do not follow its flight numbers shows nothing there) whose takeoff, else landing, starts within the leg's service date in its own time zone; each takeoff and landing is a bracket, not a gate time, and never fills or grades any time, delay or verdict above. observed is null when that day has not begun, lies beyond the 89 days observed flights are kept or no airline is known for the number; null with observed_unavailable true when it could not be read. A flight with no operation on record (with date, none on that service date) answers on_record false with airline, url, leg, market and generated_at null and the flights observed under its callsign on date read as a UTC date, else in the last 2 UTC days; with none observed either, it is not found.

date.description: Service date YYYY-MM-DD (the departure's local date) to answer for that day's operation instead of the headlined one; from 400 days back to 3 days ahead. For a flight not on record, the UTC date its observed flights are read for.

number.description: Flight number: airline IATA or ICAO code plus number, e.g. AA1.

name: get_flight_status
title: Flight status
